prosemirror-inputrules 1.5.1: ^ matches 500 characters before the cursor in long textblocks

Source code

prosemirror-inputrules only matches a rule against the last 500 characters before the cursor (MAX_MATCH). In a longer textblock, ^ matches at the start of that window, not at the start of the textblock. Each paragraph below puts a marker exactly 500 characters before its end.

Blockquote: wrappingInputRule(/^>\s/)

Click Reset, then type x y z.

Expected: the paragraph ends with xyz.
Actual: x deletes the previous character and wraps the paragraph in a blockquote. y is inserted. z wraps again, so blockquotes nest.


    

    

      
Code block: textblockTypeInputRule(/^```(\S*)\s$/)

      
Click Reset, then type a space.

      
Expected: the paragraph ends with a space.

      Actual: the paragraph becomes a code block, and the 500 characters before the cursor are deleted. The $ anchor doesn't help, because \S* grows to fill the window.
